instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside a martial arts gym with grey mats, the man in the white t-shirt (R1) on the left and the man in the grey t-shirt (R2) on the right are locked in a tight Muay Thai clinch. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) wears black goggles and white shin guards, looking forward with a focused expression as his head presses against his partner's shoulder. The man in the grey t-shirt (R2) wears black shorts and black-and-yellow shin guards, wrapping his arms around his partner's torso. In the background, a bystander in a black t-shirt and white pants stands watching. Neutral indoor overhead lighting casts soft shadows across the cool grey training area.
